question: What kind of knowledge gives true liberation without any trace of ignorance?
premises: There is knowledge of the true knowable reality that is entirely free from all limitations.
Where no limitation remains, ignorance has no place.
inference: Therefore only unlimited knowledge of reality is the giver of true liberation.
plain_english: But the knowledge of the true knowable reality that is completely free from all limitations leaves no room anywhere for ignorance and gives true liberation.
